posts.text:
What happened to  Newport Beach last night?

400 arrested, ton of fights, fireworks thrown at crowds + police during 4th of July celebration.

This is supposed to be one of the wealthiest & safest cities in America.

It’s a shame!

Celebrate the 4th but we gotta protect our own.
posts.summary: Condemns outbreak of violence and lawlessness at July 4th celebration
